notes.title: Yume No Office Official Release
notes.notes:
We are excited to announce that Yume No Office will be released on September 13th. We hope that if you've added the game to your wishlist, you'll support the studio by purchasing it. The game will have a 10% discount at launch.

If you want to learn more about its mechanics, check out the showcase previously released on our YouTube channel.
